description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a software engineer who is as comfortable shipping code as they are talking to the people who use it. Veritus is a YC-backed startup rebuilding loan servicing and collections with AI, giving fintechs, credit card issuers, and collection agencies the ability to launch, tune, and A/B test AI agents across voice, chat, SMS, and email, all while staying compliant.

You'll work across our full stack (TypeScript, React, Next.js, on Google Cloud) building the core product, and you'll also get hands-on time helping translate real customer requirements into working agent logic, integrations, and experiments. This is a generalist role for someone who wants full-stack ownership and real exposure to customers, not a narrow specialist track.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and ship features across our web application and backend services in TypeScript, React, and Next.js

 - Design and build APIs and integrations that connect our platform to external systems (CRMs, payment platforms, telephony, etc.)

 - Work directly with customers, sales, and product to turn real-world requirements and compliance constraints into working, testable product logic

 - Use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, and similar) as a core part of how you build, not an afterthought

 - Help design and analyze experiments (A/B tests) to improve business outcomes for our clients

 - Get exposure to the unique challenges of building real-time, AI-native voice and chat systems


ABOUT YOU

 - 0-3 years of professional software engineering experience, including strong new grads with solid internships

 - A track record of building modern web applications in TypeScript and React

 - Comfortable building and consuming APIs; some backend exposure (Python a plus) is helpful but not required

 - Genuinely excited about AI, both as a builder of AI products and as a user of AI development tools

 - A strong communicator who enjoys engaging directly with customers and non-engineering partners, not just other engineers

 - Strong product intuition and a bias toward simple, working solutions over perfect ones

 - Based in San Francisco, CA and willing to work in person

 - Excited to work in a fast-paced startup environment where your role will evolve


NICE TO HAVE

 - Exposure to AI/ML systems, orchestration frameworks, or LLM evaluation

 - Experience in financial services, healthcare, or another compliance-heavy environment

 - Fluency in Spanish


TECH STACK

 - Languages: TypeScript, with some Python

 - Frameworks: Next.js, React

 - Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (primary), with some AWS


BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation package, including equity

 - Inclusive healthcare package

 - Stipends for AI tools like Codex and Claude Code

 - Flexible time off


ABOUT VERITUS

Veritus is an AI communications platform for financial services. Our AI voice and text agents are live handling thousands of conversations every day for major clients across the consumer lending lifecycle: helping to drive conversion in application funnels, handling inbound servicing, and taking payments in outbound collections.

By combining cutting-edge voice AI with deep regulatory compliance and vertical specialization, we're able to help our clients significantly improve their performance without any human involvement.

We joined Y Combinator's Summer 2025 batch and are backed by repeat founders with deep experience in AI, fintech, and regulated industries.

Veritus is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
